name: op_resize_grow_reflow
description: RESIZE GROW — SOUNDNESS when the grow also REFLOWS. Sibling of e2e/op-resize-grow-exposed-strip.json, which pins the tight case over a fixed layout; this one pins the hard case. `.bar` is `width: 100%`, so growing 500x600 -> 800x900 changes pixels INSIDE the old area as well as exposing the new L, and the incremental path has to union the display-list diff with `compute_resize_damage` to get both. A repaint that only covered the exposed L would leave the stretched bar stale, which `assert_damage_sound` catches twice over: coverage (every changed pixel, and every pixel outside the 500x600 overlap counts as changed by definition, must lie inside the damage set) and `pixel_identity` (the damage-driven framebuffer must equal an independent full repaint at 800x900). `forbid_full` plus `max_area_ratio` 0.90 keep it a PATCH: the measured repaint is 73.1% of the 800x900 window — large, because 420000 of the 720000 px really are newly exposed — and the pre-fix behaviour was FrameDamage::Full, i.e. 100%, which both assertions reject. 0.90 is chosen to sit clearly above the measurement and clearly below a full-frame redraw.
